content:
Here comes the month of June! Some thoughts going into next week:

(1) Looking at the indices, we are now in a much different market environment (chop/sideways) compared to last month (up trending). This was reflected in the waning momentum in individual stocks as leaders are trading near previous highs and ideally needs time (at the very least) to consolidate. Currently, even if the indices break out of the sideways ranges, there is still a fair amount of congestion to the left hand side of the chart to work through before all time highs.

(2) Looking at BTCUSD as a risk-on/risk-off indicator, it is now trading below the 20-EMA and has shown relative weakness as of late. Not saying it is going to go down now, but at the very least some consolidation is needed for the next leg higher (momo is slowing).

(3) The semis as a group looks weak to me - especially when you consider it in the context that we had a monster move off the lows since April. $SOXX is still living below the 200-SMA.

(4) Gold is basing and we are beginning to see percolative action in the gold miners. Last I remember at the beginning of the year, stocks weren't doing too well when gold made its move higher - I won't read into this too much and just trust what the price action is telling us.

(5) On an individual stock level, many names that ripped higher formed very deep cups (>50%). Think PLTR, HIMS, APP, HOOD, TSLA. I am **NOT** saying that they will resolve as punchbowl of deaths - that is a possibility. But on the other hand if we follow the narrative that this is going to be a dot-com like AI bull market, again, much more consolidation needed to set up a healthy next move higher (think Mark Minervini VCPs).

Putting my thoughts together, I am of the belief that the aggressive trading tactics last month won't work (it already hasn't for me). Rather, I will look to reduce my trade frequency and trade size till I gain traction again. Have a good trading week ahead!
